thread:
mira: Nightly alert — rerank toolcall failures jumped on q4a candidate (prompt_set_14).

ci-bot: nightly matrix: https://ci.redwood/plots/2005 rerank_failures=93 :warning:

zach: quick grep — majority from q4a quantized runs, small number from q4m. Noted a pattern: boolean fields coming through as digits.

raj: saw that in traces too. Example validator snippet:
```
fncall validator error: field keep_active expected boolean got 1
payload: {\"query\":\"best backup approach\", \"candidates\":[\"A\",\"B\"], \"keep_active\":1}
```

ellie: can someone produce a minimal repro (seed, prompt, model + quant config)? we'll need it for local run.

mira: repro details attached from nightly job:
MODEL=q4a_v1.4
PROMPT=\"Rerank by helpfulness:\\nQuestion: How to backup Postgres?\"
SEED=7
# API returned function_call with args JSON showing ints instead of booleans

karen: hypothesis: compact_encoder is coercing bool->int somewhere during compactification in the q4 path.

raj: confirmed — commit 3f4d2e altered compact_encode handling for size heuristics and it cast bools to ints for compactness.
This matches the exact timeframe of the regression.

mira: consequence: our strict JSON schema validator rejects these toolcall args (schema expects true/false). Nightly flags as failures.

zach: mitigation options:
- add permissive validator that accepts 0/1 for booleans and coerces
- shim in parse_tool_args to coerce numeric 0/1 -> false/true for functioncall args only
- revert the commit in compact encoder

ellie: I'd prefer a shim as quick mitigation, plus unit tests and metrics; follow up with either revert or a proper encoder fix.

raj: I'll draft a tiny shim at the runtime ingress that converts int 0/1 to booleans for schema-typed fields. Also adding roundtrip unit test for compact_encode.

karen: please add a statsd metric 'toolcall.coercions' with tags {model, quant, prompt_set} so we can monitor scope.

devops-bot: created ticket INF-3347: \"compact_encoder bool->int regression causing toolcall schema rejects\" assigned @raj @mira severity=P1 https://tickets.redwood/INF-3347

mira: hotfix branch pushed, running targeted nightly for prompt_set_14 and quick sweep across q4a/q4m/q8.

ci-bot: rerun triggered: https://ci.redwood/2005/run/2 (hotfix)

mira: local + canary results: prompt_set_14 rerank fail rate dropped from 12% -> 0.6% on canary. Coercion metric shows 102 coercions during the run.

raj: added unit/integration tests to cover compact_encode and parse_tool_args path; CI green.

platform-reviewer: reviewing INF-3347 and the hotfix patch. if canary stable for 4 hours we'll promote; otherwise consider rollback of 3f4d2e.

ellie: sgtm. after promotion, schedule a follow-up to either permanently fix encoder behavior or document the bool handling contract.

mira: timeline: hotfix -> canary -> monitor 4h -> promote. updating INF-3347 with all results and logs.

zach: thanks — good catch. tagging @sec & @compliance for awareness in case any other strict schemas are affected.

mira: closing loop once promoted. :thumbsup:
